meta.name: Condition-Adaptive UAV Detection - ISEF Demo
meta.notes: Scenario variants reuse one base clip with deterministic condition transforms; scores/weights are precomputed from final run artifacts.

demo_script: Start on Easy daylight and press Play for 3 seconds.
Switch to Noisy audio and show adaptive weighting.
Switch to Low-light / IR and note robustness under vision degradation.
Open Tiny far target (WOW #1): vision missing, fusion still responds.
Open Radar dropout (WOW #2): radar missing and gate shifts accordingly.
Use scrubber to verify synchronized overlays.
Point to Final Test Score Comparison for authoritative ranking.
Reset to default and replay in under 2 minutes.

scenarios.title: Low-light / IR
scenarios.demonstrates: Vision degraded; adaptive fusion stays robust.

scenarios.title: Noisy audio
scenarios.demonstrates: Audio degraded; gate shifts toward vision/radar.

scenarios.title: Radar clutter
scenarios.demonstrates: Radar clutter rises; gate down-weights radar.

scenarios.title: Vision dropout
scenarios.demonstrates: WOW: vision unavailable, fusion uses audio+radar.

scenarios.title: Radar dropout
scenarios.demonstrates: WOW: radar unavailable, fusion uses vision+audio.
